one_liner: Offline paint mixing workbench: build recipes from your own tubes, compute ratios to hit a target color, save and scale mixes
target_user: watercolor, gouache and acrylic painters who mix colors by hand
core_job: paint color mixing recipe calculator with personal tube palette
primary_interaction: pick target color -> get ratio recipe from owned tubes -> save and scale the mix
wedge_hypothesis: existing color-mixing apps are generic color pickers or games; painters need tube-bound ratio math, offline in the studio
